context.situation: You want a library card. The receptionist asks for your name, your age and your phone number.
context.situation_ar: تريد بطاقة مكتبة. الموظف يسألك عن اسمك وعمرك ورقم هاتفك.
context.goal: Say your age and your phone number, and ask someone to repeat.
context.goal_ar: أن تقول عمرك ورقم هاتفك، وتطلب من شخص أن يعيد كلامه.

script.t: Hello. Can I have your name, please?
Thank you. And how old are you, Ali?
Nineteen. OK. What's your phone number?
It's oh seven seven oh, four one five, two six three eight.
Sorry, can you say that again?
Sure. Oh seven seven oh, four one five, two six three eight.
Thank you. Here's your card. Welcome to the library!

gist.prompt: What does Ali get at the end?

explain.1: Nine-TEEN (19) has the stress at the end. NINE-ty (90) has it at the start.

notice.quote: How old are you? — I'm nineteen.

question.prompt: Which verb does Ali use for his age?
question.prompt_ar: أي فعل يستخدم علي للتعبير عن عمره؟

explain.1: In English we don't "have" years. We ARE an age.

notice.explain: For age, English uses be: I'm 19. Not "I have 19 years".
notice.explain_ar: للعمر نستخدم be: I'm 19 وليس I have 19 years.

notice.quote: Sorry, can you say that again?

question.prompt: Why does the receptionist say this?

notice.explain: Use this polite question when you don't understand. It's one of the most useful sentences in English.
notice.explain_ar: استخدم هذا السؤال المهذب عندما لا تفهم. من أكثر الجمل فائدة.

grammar.title: Age: I'm + number
grammar.context: How old are you? — I'm nineteen.
grammar.pattern: I'm / He's / She's + number (+ years old)
examples: How old is your brother? — He's thirty.
grammar.explain: Use be (am / is / are) for age. "Years old" is optional.
grammar.explain_ar: نستخدم be للعمر، وعبارة years old اختيارية.

errors.why: For age we use be: he is 21.

practice.why: For age we use be, not have.

practice.prompt: Listen and write the number in words.
Listen and write the number in words.

pronunciation.title: -teen or -ty?
pronunciation.tip: 13, 14, 15…: stress at the END (thir-TEEN). 30, 40, 50…: stress at the START (THIR-ty).
pronunciation.tip_ar: الأعداد 13-19 النبرة في آخرها، والأعداد 30، 40… النبرة في أولها.

pronunciation.title: Ask politely
pronunciation.tip: Your voice goes up at the end of "again?"
lines: Sorry, can you say that again?

retrieval.prompt: You don't understand. Ask the person to repeat (5–6 words).
retrieval.prompt_ar: لم تفهم. اطلب من الشخص أن يعيد (5-6 كلمات).
